_comment: Documented divergences of the Go engine against the event_stream corpus (kind events). Fail-closed: a failing case NOT listed here is red; a listed case that starts reproducing the reference envelopes is red (stale baseline); a listed case that never ran is red. The corpus-advisory xfail case (evt_decoding_error_unreachable) is skipped by the runner and needs no entry.

cases.event_stream/evt_access_denied_decorator: the reference BaseSecurityDecorator sender seam (send_access_denied_event) has no Go counterpart: the decorator module is not ported, and the bus exposes no access_denied emitter
cases.event_stream/evt_authentication_failed_d: the reference BaseSecurityDecorator sender seam (send_authentication_failed_event) has no Go counterpart: the decorator module is not ported, and the bus exposes no authentication_failed emitter
cases.event_stream/evt_behavioral_violation_us: the behavioral_violation emission (guardcore/behavior.go emitBehaviorEvent) reports action_taken 'logged' where the reference pins the rule action 'log', and SendHandlerEvent carries no rule_type envelope column
cases.event_stream/evt_cloud_blocked_provider: the bus strips the decorator_type kwarg from metadata (guardcore/events.go SendMiddlewareEvent deletes decorator_type after promoting it to the envelope column); the reference keeps it in both places
cases.event_stream/evt_content_filtered_max_si: the route max_request_size denial emits no content_filtered event in the Go pipeline (the route guard's content-filter emission is not wired)
cases.event_stream/evt_country_blocked_geo: the Go route country denial adds the decorator_violation access-denied event beside country_blocked, and SendHandlerEvent carries no rule_type envelope column; the reference pins country_blocked alone with rule_type set
cases.event_stream/evt_csp_violation_report: SecurityHeadersEventsMixin is not ported: the security headers manager has no csp_violation emitter (KNOWN_GAPS milestone 6)
cases.event_stream/evt_custom_request_check_re: the check_function metadata quotes the Go function name (runtime.FuncForPC, 'corpusRejectAll') where the reference pins the python __name__ 'corpus_reject_all'; Go identifiers cannot carry the marker verbatim
cases.event_stream/evt_decorator_violation_aut: the route auth denial prefixes 'Authentication failure: ' to the reason, and the bus drops the decorator_type metadata kwarg (SendMiddlewareEvent)
cases.event_stream/evt_dynamic_rule_violation_: the tiered endpoint block emits only dynamic_rule_violation; the reference also emits the manager rate_limited envelope (endpoint/method columns, global config limit in metadata) beside it
cases.event_stream/evt_geo_lookup_failed_downl: the download-failure reason renders the Go error type ('*url.Error') where the reference pins the python exception class name ('RuntimeError')
cases.event_stream/evt_https_enforced_redirect: the harness request carries no URL scheme so original_scheme renders empty, and the https_enforced emission (guardcore/events.go SendHTTPSViolationEvent) renders the redirect URL with the full path where the reference pins the scheme-swapped origin
cases.event_stream/evt_ip_ban_failed_escalatio: no ban fault injection seam: the Go port's local ban path cannot fail deterministically (guardcore IPBanManager.Ban only errors on invalid input or Redis failures)
cases.event_stream/evt_ip_blocked_global_black: the ip_blocked emission (guardcore/pipeline.go) prefixes the block-hook log reason ('IP not allowed: ...') and omits the ip_address metadata kwarg
cases.event_stream/evt_path_excluded_health: the exclusion matcher in Engine.Check emits no path_excluded event (the reference emits from RequestValidator.is_path_excluded)
cases.event_stream/evt_pattern_added_custom: the Go detection corpus is a compile-time table (KNOWN_GAPS): no sus-patterns runtime registry exists, so pattern_added has no emitter
cases.event_stream/evt_pattern_detected_xss: the Go detection corpus is a compile-time table (KNOWN_GAPS): guardcore.Detect is a pure function with no sus-patterns telemetry seam, so pattern_detected has no emitter
cases.event_stream/evt_pattern_removed_custom: the Go detection corpus is a compile-time table (KNOWN_GAPS): no sus-patterns runtime registry exists, so pattern_removed has no emitter
cases.event_stream/evt_penetration_attempt_blo: the penetration_attempt emission carries no request_count or trigger_info metadata (the per-IP request counter and the trigger-info kwarg are not ported)
cases.event_stream/evt_penetration_attempt_pas: the passive-mode emission reports the suspicious-activity log reason ('Suspicious activity detected: ...') where the reference pins the decorator reason ('Suspicious pattern detected (passive mode): ...'), and the request_count/trigger_info/passive_mode metadata are not carried
cases.event_stream/evt_rate_limited_global: the rate_limited handler-direct emission (guardcore/pipeline.go) omits the endpoint/method envelope columns and renders the handler-log reason ('Rate limit exceeded for IP: ...') instead of the reference 'Rate limit exceeded: N requests in Ws window'
cases.event_stream/evt_redis_connection_establ: the Go RedisManager.Initialize logs the connection instead of emitting redis_connection (no handler-direct redis emitter yet)
cases.event_stream/evt_redis_error_connection_: the Go RedisManager.Initialize logs the failure instead of emitting redis_error, and the reference reason quotes the redis-py error rendering
cases.event_stream/evt_security_bypass_all: the route bypass short-circuit in Engine.Check emits no security_bypass event (the reference emits from BypassHandler.handle_security_bypass)
cases.event_stream/evt_security_headers_applie: SecurityHeadersEventsMixin is not ported: the security headers manager has no security_headers_applied emitter (KNOWN_GAPS milestone 6)
cases.event_stream/evt_suspicious_request_untr: the trusted-proxy extraction path emits no suspicious_request event: the reference ip_extraction spoof-detection seam has no Go counterpart (resolveClientIP has no proxy-chain analysis)
